extension.description: An interactive 3D preview environment for OpenSCAD (.scad) files.
config.previewFormat: The format to use for the 3D preview. 3MF supports colors but requires OpenSCAD Nightly. STL is universally supported.
config.slicerExecutable: Optional path to the slicer executable (e.g., Bambu Studio or PrusaSlicer). If left empty, the OS default application for the 3D model will be used.
config.executablePath: Path to the OpenSCAD executable. Leave empty to use automatic detection or the system PATH.
config.enableLazyUnion: Enable lazy unions, creating a multi-part exported object.
config.parameterLabel: Label of the fields in the Parameters tab.
config.parameterLabel.name: Variable name, formatted (default).
config.parameterLabel.description: Comment written above the variable (accents allowed); the variable name when there is no comment.
